visualCharacteristics.layout: Two columns on tablet/desktop: image takes 1/3, text takes 2/3 (stacked on mobile, image first); the text ends with a pill CTA button (e.g. 'Find out more', external links open in a new tab). Placed in a section styled 'light-grey', usually after a default-content heading

contentPattern: One row, two cells: cell 1 = image; cell 2 = paragraph(s) followed by a CTA link in its own paragraph. Authoring the image in cell 2 puts it on the right
